t_advice_summary_textbox.text: You will have a choice of gnomes to choose when you are trying to get the most mushrooms. They are either red/pink or blue/green. There will be gnomes who pay more than others and one that won't give any mushrooms at all. Take note of it

vb_textbox.text: In the forest you will be picking mushrooms. Gnomes will appear to how many mushrooms they will be able to pick. They will change colour and pick a different of mushrooms. By process of elimination you will need to work out which colour gnomes gives out the most mushrooms.
